title: Korean BBQ Beef Ssam
description: A twist on traditional Korean BBQ, served with a crispy bun and sweet ssam sauce. This recipe is perfect for a quick dinner or lunch.

ingredients.name: Ssam sauce
ingredients.notes: available in most Asian grocery stores

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, and ginger. Add the sliced beef and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat. Remove the beef from the marinade and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired doneness.
Meanwhile, toast the buns by grilling them for 1-2 minutes, or until lightly browned.
Assemble the ssam by placing a piece of beef onto each bun, followed by a spoonful of kimchi, a sprinkle of green onions, and a drizzle of ssam sauce.
Wrap the bun in a Canadian wrap and serve immediately.
